Horticalc 0.6.4 expands the fertilizer catalogue and improves the packaged
application, UI wording, and documentation.

## Highlights

- Added common mineral salts and trace-element sources for building nutrient
  solutions from basic chemicals.
- Added the Horticalc leaf icon to the packaged Windows application and
  installer, with clearer recovery instructions for blocked portable ZIPs.
- Refined technical UI terminology across all five languages.
- Rebuilt the documentation around installation, real workflows, data formats,
  the Solver, CLI/API use, development, and releases.

Download the Windows installer, portable Windows ZIP, or Linux x86_64 archive
below. Matching SHA-256 files and GitHub Artifact Attestations are published
with the release.
